findings.cause: retained_nodes_v1.py passes str(root/relative) to socket_is_absent. _native_socket_absent checks only that canonical absolute byte string is absent from the raw /proc/net/unix address strings. AF_UNIX records the original bound address; an equivalent relative/noncanonical spelling can differ even while the same scoped socket remains live.
findings.effect: The helper can accept a live scoped socket as kernel-inactive, count it as retained metadata and allow stopped-retention credit. This violates the all-discovered-sockets-inactive contract and matters especially for additional discovered sockets without authenticated original bind path and lost historical descendants.
findings.reproduction: The exact extracted _native_socket_absent blocks a fake canonical absolute live address but returns True for equivalent relative, redundant-separator and dot-component bind-address fixtures. No actual kernel/process/endpoint probe was used.
findings.requested_fix: Publish a fresh sealed successor that fails closed for any scoped socket without a separately justified exact kernel-address/identity mapping, or rejects additional/unqualified sockets. Any stronger mapping must cover relative paths, lexical equivalents and aliases without following payloads or asserting complete historical writer absence. Add these fake-only negative cases.
